purpose: External financial benchmark evaluation, kept separate from FinSight training corpus.

recommended_benchmarks.name: FinQA
recommended_benchmarks.notes: Use the public test split with references for local evaluation. Do not train on the test split.

recommended_benchmarks.name: ConvFinQA
recommended_benchmarks.notes: Use conversation-level evaluation for multi-turn behavior or turn-level evaluation for individual questions.

recommended_benchmarks.name: TAT-QA
recommended_benchmarks.notes: Use the official test set and evaluation script.

recommended_benchmarks.name: FiQA
recommended_benchmarks.notes: Preserve the benchmark's original evaluation protocol.

custom_test.name: FinSight Custom Financial Test Set
custom_test.notes: All questions use three new fictional held-out documents, separate from the 12 training PDFs.
